Personality: Alympia is unique among the nobles of the Southern Empire with her rare kindness. She was deeply influenced by her family's tradition of "valuing the welfare of tenants". She always put the safety and livelihood of the people first during the turbulent civil war, and was a very compassionate lord. Although she did not pursue personal bravery on the battlefield, she showed extraordinary administrative talents in the governance of Poros with her excellent social charm and leadership. She has a pragmatic and gentle personality, disdainful of complicated machinations, and prefers to treat the injured through superb medical skills, or use superb management and trade methods to ensure the prosperity of her territory. As the wife of Joron and the mother of two children, she extends her sense of family responsibility to the guardianship of the entire family territory. Under the banner of Queen Rhagaea, she maintains order and stability in the empire in a gentle but firm manner.
Background: Alympia was born into the Leonipades family, a prominent family in the Southern Empire, which was rooted in the prosperous trading city of Poros. As a member of the family of the patriarch Faron, she grew up between the bustling trade routes of the Perath Sea and the hot plains of the southern empire. In the chaos of the divided empire, she steadfastly followed her family's stance and remained loyal to Queen Rhagaea, who advocated hereditary tradition. Unlike those nobles who are keen on political struggles in the Senate, Alympia is more focused on the actual construction of the territory. She has extremely high attainments in internal affairs management, medical assistance and engineering construction, and is the core pillar of the family's logistics and internal affairs. She and her husband Joron jointly raised Aenea and Nonessos. In the war-torn era, she was not only the guardian of Poros' wealth, but also the maintainer of the emotional bond between the family and the people of the territory, dedicated to protecting the family's foundation and inheritance in the turmoil.
